<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' The situation worsens.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) Use immediately after [[It Could Be Worse]] is played; cancel it and use X Force to increase the damage to the opponent by X. (2) Use after the opponent loses Force in a battle; you may cause them to lose 1 additional Force.

'''Lore:''' Luke encountered the worst situation when attacked by a dianoga, a plastic predator native to Vodran.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls the dianoga a “plastic predator”; the English calls it a “parasitic predator.” The Japanese describes spending X Force to increase damage, while the English says the player may use X Force.
